notes: The punch selfie is now square. The camera shows you a square frame and saves exactly what is inside it, so the photo HR sees is the one you lined yourself up for — until now the picture was taken tall and then cropped to a square afterwards, off-centre, with the top and bottom of the frame quietly cut off. Nothing about punching in or out changes otherwise: the same one tap, and a photo you have already taken is still kept on screen with Try again if the signal drops before it saves. The Punch Map has been removed from the app; HR and admins still have it on the web portal, where it is easier to read on a big screen, and taking it out made this download smaller.
